_doc: Allowlist for tests/storage-locations.test.mjs. Every entry: where (file, repo-relative), key (storage key or SharedPreferences name), category (debug-flag | cache | device-specific | pending-migration | legacy-cleanup | framework), reason (one line). User-visible settings must NOT be added here as permanent exceptions: they belong in settings.json (pending-migration entries are temporary and name the target store).

Legacy spectrogram settings, read once into settings.json (uiPreferences.spectrogram) when that has none, then removed.
Legacy v1 spectrogram settings (colour map, window, dB floor), read once into settings.json when that has none, then removed.
Legacy A/B compare preferences, read once into settings.json (uiPreferences.spectrogramCompare), then removed.
Legacy cover edit options, read once into settings.json (uiPreferences.coverEdit), then removed.
Older cover edit options key, only removed (never carried over).
Legacy artist column width, read once into settings.json (uiPreferences.artistIndexTitleWidthPx), then removed.
Legacy last lyrics settings tab, read once into settings.json (uiPreferences.lyricsSettingsTab), then removed.
